recent: LAC Med 于2026年10月获得 Health Capitol 一份价值最高 RM20 million、为期七年的医疗影像解决方案合约。公司截至2026年6月30日的季度营收环比增长55.3%，净利环比增长410.9%。此外，公司于9月更换了公司秘书并变更了注册地址。

recent_en: LAC Med secured a seven-year medical imaging solutions contract worth up to RM20 million from Health Capitol in October 2026. Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 55.3% QoQ, with net income up 410.9% QoQ. The company also changed its company secretaries and registered address in September.
notable_en: Secured a seven-year medical imaging solutions contract worth up to RM20 million from Health Capitol.
Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 55.3% QoQ and net income rose 410.9% QoQ.
earnings_en: Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 was MYR45.599 million, up 55.3% QoQ; net income was MYR5.267 million, up 410.9% QoQ; net margin was 11.6% versus 3.5% in the prior quarter.
